summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held on July 31, 2026, in Amsterdam. The EGM approved the appointment of Andrea Cesaroni as a member of the Executive Board, effective immediately, making the board consist of CEO Steven van Rijswijk, CFO Ida Lerner, and CRO Cesaroni. This is a routine corporate governance event, not a special situation. No transaction, activist activity, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. What to watch: no further action expected; this is purely informational.
